interfaces.notes: 5 Gb/s x 8/10 / 8 = 500 MB/s before link/protocol overhead (UASP HDD/SSD bridges typically ~400-450 MB/s). USB-IF-hosted paper: single-lane 5.0 Gb/s 'is listed as 4 Gb/s, taking into account the 8b/10b encoding overhead': https://www.usb.org/sites/default/files/Power%20Savings%20in%20USB%20Hub%20Through%20a%20Proactive%20Scheduling%20Strategy.pdf
